related_destination_note: Travelling to Northern Ireland? It has separate entry requirements from Great Britain, not covered on this page.

requirements.title: Microchip recorded (ISO 11784/11785)
requirements.description: The microchip must be implanted before, or on the same day as, the rabies vaccination used for travel.

requirements.title: Rabies vaccination valid (on/after the microchip)
requirements.description: The rabies vaccination must be valid on the entry date; a first-time or lapsed dose adds a 21-day wait before it counts as valid for travel.

requirements.title: Tapeworm treatment (Echinococcus), 24-120h before arrival
scope_notes: Waived when departing directly from: Finland, Ireland, Northern Ireland, Malta, Norway

manual_checklist.title: Travel within 5 days of your pet
manual_checklist.detail: For ordinary non-commercial travel, your pet must enter Great Britain within 5 days before or after you. Outside that window it counts as commercial import with stricter rules.

manual_checklist.title: APHIS endorsement within 10 days of arrival
manual_checklist.detail: USDA APHIS must endorse the health certificate, and the endorsement must be completed within 10 days of arrival in Great Britain. Build the APHIS turnaround into your timeline.

manual_checklist.title: Sign the non-commercial declaration
manual_checklist.detail: You (or an authorised person travelling with your pet) sign this official GOV.UK form to confirm your pet will not be sold or transferred to a new owner in the UK.

manual_checklist.title: Approved route + manifest cargo
manual_checklist.detail: Enter via an approved air/sea/tunnel route. Pets flying normally travel as manifest cargo, not checked baggage or in the cabin (a UK-recognised assistance dog may be an exception — confirm with the airline AND the arrival airport before booking).

manual_checklist.title: Airline brachycephalic + breed restrictions
manual_checklist.detail: Some carriers refuse short-nosed breeds or certain dog breeds. Confirm with the airline at booking, not at the gate.
